findings.consequence: Acceptance criterion 7's diff/static gate is not satisfied for the pushed artifact, even though the executable guard suites pass.
findings.correction: Preserve the raw RED log as evidence, but record it in a diff-check-clean representation or exclude only that evidence line using an explicit, documented gate policy; then rerun the full changed-range gate and obtain new independent gates on the final pushed SHA.
